# TONAPI Python SDK

> Python SDK for TONAPI — query blockchain data via REST, subscribe to real-time events via SSE/WebSocket, and receive webhook notifications. Python 3.10+, runtime deps: aiohttp 3.9+, pydantic 2.4+.

Install: `pip install pytonapi`. API key is optional for REST (0.24 RPS without key), required for streaming and webhooks. Get one at [tonconsole.com](https://tonconsole.com/).

Networks: `Network.MAINNET` (tonapi.io), `Network.TESTNET` (testnet.tonapi.io), `Network.TETRA` (tetra.tonapi.io).

The SDK has three transports:

- **REST API** — query accounts, blocks, transactions, Jettons, NFTs, DNS, staking, and more. Rate-limited client with automatic retries and exponential backoff for 429/500/502/503/504.
- **Streaming** — real-time subscriptions via SSE (simpler, single connection) or WebSocket (bidirectional, JSON-RPC 2.0). Subscribe to transactions, blocks, traces, and mempool messages. Automatic reconnection with configurable policy.
- **Webhooks** — push notifications for account transactions, mempool messages, opcode subscriptions, and new contract deployments. Decorator-based event dispatcher with automatic webhook setup and token verification.

Client: `TonapiRestClient` (async context manager) exposes resource groups as attributes (`client.accounts`, `client.blockchain`, `client.jettons`, etc.). Automatic retries with exponential backoff for 429/500/502/503/504. Without an API key, the SDK auto-limits to ~0.24 RPS (1 per 4 s) client-side; with a key, rate limiting is off unless set explicitly via `rps_limit`. Pass `ApiKey` objects with per-key rate limits (`api_key=[ApiKey("k1", rps_limit=10), ApiKey("k2", rps_limit=25)]`) for key rotation on 429. Streaming: `TonapiStreaming` exposes `TonapiSSE` and `TonapiWebSocket` transports with async iterator subscriptions (`async for event in streaming.sse.subscribe_transactions()`). Webhooks: `TonapiWebhookClient` for HTTP CRUD + `TonapiWebhookDispatcher` for event dispatch with decorators (`@dispatcher.account_tx()`, `@dispatcher.mempool_msg()`, etc.).

Import paths:

```python
from pytonapi.rest import TonapiRestClient
from pytonapi.streaming import TonapiStreaming, TonapiSSE, TonapiWebSocket
from pytonapi.streaming import BlockEvent, TransactionEvent, TraceEvent, MempoolEvent
from pytonapi.webhook import TonapiWebhookClient, TonapiWebhookDispatcher, TonapiWebhook
from pytonapi.webhook import WebhookEventType, WebhookInfo, AccountSubscription
from pytonapi.webhook import AccountTxEvent, MempoolMsgEvent, OpcodeMsgEvent, NewContractsEvent
from pytonapi.types import Network, Workchain, Opcode, ApiKey, RetryPolicy, RetryRule, ReconnectPolicy
from pytonapi.utils import raw_to_userfriendly, userfriendly_to_raw, to_nano, to_amount
from pytonapi.exceptions import TONAPIError
```

## Docs

- [Overview](https://tonapi.ness.su/index.md): Installation, quick start, networks, API key plans.
- [Guide](https://tonapi.ness.su/guide.md): Client configuration, sessions, retries, key rotation, utilities, error handling.

## REST API

Query accounts, blocks, transactions, Jettons, NFTs, DNS, staking, and more via the TON API.

- [REST Overview](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/overview.md): Resource groups, SDK usage, endpoints.

### Accounts

- [Get Accounts](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_accounts_post.md): Get multiple accounts by list of addresses.
- [Get Account](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_get.md): Get account info by address.
- [Account Dns Back Resolve](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/account_dns_back_resolve_get.md): Reverse DNS resolve for an account.
- [Get Account Jettons Balances](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_jettons_balances_get.md): All Jetton balances for an account.
- [Get Account Jetton Balance](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_jetton_balance_get.md): Single Jetton balance for an account.
- [Get Account Jettons History](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_jettons_history_get.md): Jetton transfer history for an account.
- [Get Account Jetton History By Id](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_jetton_history_by_id_get.md): Jetton transfer history for a specific Jetton.
- [Get Account Nft Items](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_nft_items_get.md): NFT items owned by an account.
- [Get Account Events](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_events_get.md): Events for an account.
- [Get Account Event](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_event_get.md): Single event for an account by event ID.
- [Get Account Traces](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_traces_get.md): Traces for an account.
- [Get Account Subscriptions](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_subscriptions_get.md): Subscriptions for an account.
- [Reindex Account](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/reindex_account_post.md): Trigger account reindexing.
- [Search Accounts](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/search_accounts_get.md): Search accounts by name or domain.
- [Get Account Dns Expiring](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_dns_expiring_get.md): DNS domains expiring for an account.
- [Get Account Public Key](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_public_key_get.md): Public key for an account.
- [Get Account Multisigs](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_multisigs_get.md): Multisig wallets for an account.
- [Get Account Diff](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_diff_get.md): Account balance diff for a time period.
- [Get Account Extra Currency History By Id](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_extra_currency_history_by_id_get.md): Extra currency history for an account.
- [Get Jetton Account History By Id](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_jetton_account_history_by_id_get.md): Jetton account history by Jetton ID.
- [Emulate Message To Account Event](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/emulate_message_to_account_event_post.md): Emulate a message and get account event.

### Blockchain

- [Get Reduced Blockchain Blocks](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_reduced_blockchain_blocks_get.md): Reduced blockchain blocks for a time range.
- [Get Blockchain Block](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_block_get.md): Block data by block ID.
- [Download Blockchain Block Boc](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/download_blockchain_block_boc_get.md): Download block BOC by block ID.
- [Get Blockchain Masterchain Shards](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_masterchain_shards_get.md): Shards for a masterchain seqno.
- [Get Blockchain Masterchain Blocks](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_masterchain_blocks_get.md): Recent masterchain blocks.
- [Get Blockchain Masterchain Transactions](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_masterchain_transactions_get.md): Recent masterchain transactions.
- [Get Blockchain Config From Block](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_config_from_block_get.md): Blockchain config at a specific block.
- [Get Raw Blockchain Config From Block](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_raw_blockchain_config_from_block_get.md): Raw blockchain config at a specific block.
- [Get Blockchain Block Transactions](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_block_transactions_get.md): Transactions in a block.
- [Get Blockchain Transaction](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_transaction_get.md): Transaction by hash.
- [Get Blockchain Transaction By Message Hash](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_transaction_by_message_hash_get.md): Transaction by message hash.
- [Get Blockchain Validators](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_validators_get.md): Current validators.
- [Get Blockchain Masterchain Head](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_masterchain_head_get.md): Latest masterchain block.
- [Get Blockchain Raw Account](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_raw_account_get.md): Raw account state from blockchain.
- [Get Blockchain Account Transactions](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_account_transactions_get.md): Transactions for an account from blockchain.
- [Exec Get Method For Blockchain Account](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/exec_get_method_for_blockchain_account_get.md): Execute a get-method on a smart contract.
- [Exec Get Method With Body For Blockchain Account](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/exec_get_method_with_body_for_blockchain_account_post.md): Execute a get-method with body on a smart contract.
- [Send Blockchain Message](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/send_blockchain_message_post.md): Send a signed message to the blockchain.
- [Get Blockchain Config](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_blockchain_config_get.md): Current blockchain config.
- [Get Raw Blockchain Config](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_raw_blockchain_config_get.md): Current raw blockchain config.
- [Blockchain Account Inspect](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/blockchain_account_inspect_get.md): Inspect account contract type and methods.
- [Get Library By Hash](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_library_by_hash_get.md): TVM library cell by hash.

### Connect

- [Get Ton Connect Payload](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_ton_connect_payload_get.md): Generate TON Connect payload.
- [Get Account Info By State Init](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_account_info_by_state_init_post.md): Get account info from state init.

### DNS

- [Get Dns Info](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_dns_info_get.md): DNS info for a domain.
- [Dns Resolve](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/dns_resolve_get.md): Resolve a TON DNS domain.
- [Get Domain Bids](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_domain_bids_get.md): Bids for a domain auction.
- [Get All Auctions](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/get_all_auctions_get.md): All active DNS auctions.

### Emulation

- [Emulate Message To Event](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/emulate_message_to_event_post.md): Emulate a message and get event.
- [Emulate Message To Trace](https://tonapi.ness.su/rest/emulate_message_to_trace_post.md): Emulate a message and get execution trace.

## Streaming

Real-time blockchain events over SSE and WebSocket.

- [Overview](https://tonapi.ness.su/streaming/overview.md): SSE and WebSocket transports, endpoints, SDK usage.
- [Client](https://tonapi.ness.su/streaming/client.md): TonapiStreaming constructor, session lifecycle, and SSE/WebSocket transports.
- [Connection](https://tonapi.ness.su/streaming/connection.md): Reconnect policy, backoff behavior, heartbeat timeout, and graceful shutdown.
- [Events](https://tonapi.ness.su/streaming/events.md): Streaming event models — TransactionEvent, BlockEvent, TraceEvent, MempoolEvent.

## Webhooks

Push notifications for account transactions, mempool messages, opcode subscriptions, and new contract deployments.

- [Overview](https://tonapi.ness.su/webhooks/overview.md): Event types, subscription management, SDK usage.
- [Client](https://tonapi.ness.su/webhooks/client.md): TonapiWebhookClient for webhook CRUD and TonapiWebhook for managing subscriptions.
- [Dispatcher](https://tonapi.ness.su/webhooks/dispatcher.md): Decorator-based event dispatcher with automatic webhook setup and token verification.
- [Events](https://tonapi.ness.su/webhooks/events.md): Webhook event models, event types, and webhook metadata.

## OpenAPI Specification

- [OpenAPI Spec](https://tonapi.ness.su/openapi/openapi.yml): Full OpenAPI 3.0 specification.

## AI Plugin

- [Claude Code Plugin](https://github.com/nessshon/tonapi/tree/main/skills/tonapi): Install with `/plugin marketplace add nessshon/claude-plugins` then `/plugin install tonapi@nessshon-plugins`. Routing table, CLI runner for executing SDK methods, and per-resource API references for code generation.
